summary: Describes the Extensible Provisioning Protocol (EPP), an XML-based client-server protocol for provisioning objects in a shared central repository, such as domain registries. It defines generic operations and a framework for mapping them to object types. It is an Internet Standard.

eli5.summary: Registries need a standard way for registrars to add and change domain names. EPP is the common language for that, like a form every registrar fills out the same way.

questions: how do registrars talk to domain registries
